title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Premium Discount for Service Contract Holders
content:
Cover holders with a sufficiently senior service contract receive a discount on the premium of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims`.

## Who qualifies

The contract examined is the holder's service contract that is in the active status, on whichever trade lane. The discount applies when the tier's qualifying rank is not 0 and the rank of that contract is at least the qualifying rank. A holder without an active service contract receives no discount.

| Service contract tier | Rank |
|---|---|
| `AHL Starter Service Contract` | 1 |
| `AHL Standard Service Contract` | 2 |
| `AHL Regional Account Contract` | 3 |
| `AHL Key Account Contract` | 4 |
| `AHL Global Account Contract` | 5 |
| `AHL Strategic Partner Contract` | 6 |

| Cover tier | Qualifying contract rank | Discount (percent) |
|---|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 0 (no discount) | 0 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 0 (no discount) | 0 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 3 | 10 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 3 | 10 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 3 | 15 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 3 | 15 |

## How the discount acts

The **net premium** is the gross premium, meaning the premium already increased by any cargo uplift, reduced by the discount percentage. The discount is applied to that gross figure and is never merged with the uplift into a single combined rate. The net premium is not rounded.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- A holder of `AHL Key Account Contract`, active, under `AHL CargoCare Premium`, with a gross premium of 330.00: rank 4 reaches 3, so the net premium is 330.00 less 15 percent, which is 280.50.
- A holder of `AHL Standard Service Contract` under `AHL CargoCare Plus`: rank 2 falls short of 3, so no discount applies.
- A holder whose only `AHL Global Account Contract` is not in the active status has no active contract and receives no discount.
